name: Chrome extension
summary: The agent runs as a browser extension inside the user's own Chrome, so it acts with the user's real logins, cookies and tabs. This reaches sites that have no API but puts the user's accounts within reach of prompt injection.
how: User installs the agent's extension in their everyday browser
Extension reads the page and sends it to the model
Model returns actions (click, type, navigate) that the extension performs
Risky actions are paused for the user to confirm
facts: Full access to real accounts; prompt injection risk stays non-zero
goodFor: Tasks the user wants to watch
watchOut: A malicious page can try to hijack the agent
Agent shares the user's identity and data
Tied to one machine being on
